traps.description: mobile-bff v7.1.0 upgraded its HTTP client two hours earlier, the client logs handshake retries, and a past incident blames exactly that kind of upgrade; but v7.1.0 served balances fine until midnight and batch-settlement, which was not deployed, fails the same way

mobile-bff raised its minimum TLS version 30 minutes before the failures, a very tempting TLS change; but requests succeeded for 29 minutes after it and the error says the certificate expired, not that the protocol version was rejected
